exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Difficulty in Action with ～にくい".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb にくい (〜nikui) matches "Difficulty in Action with ～にくい".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb にくい (〜nikui).
exercises.explanation: Expresses that something is hard or difficult to do.
